residents.not_counted: Does not count for the village (no trade or a child)

hint.smelt.ore: Smelt in a furnace or blast furnace.

treasury.help: Each village pays by your standing with its working residents and keeps at most %s days of pay.
treasury.none: You have not found any village yet.
treasury.sent: %s emeralds went to your ender chest.
treasury.full: Your ender chest is full. %s emeralds wait in the treasury.

discover.chat: You found %s. It is now in your treasury list.

msg.trial_ready: %s trusts you enough for a trial. Talk to them.
standing.trial: A trial of trust is waiting
residents.trial: A trial of trust is waiting
reward.top_choose: You choose one when you complete the errand. Its magic is a surprise until then.
reward.top_surprise: Its magic is a surprise until you complete the errand.
choose.title: Choose your reward
choose.help: The %s opens the chest. Pick one; hover a button to see all of its magic.
msg.no_room: Make room for %s more stacks in your inventory, then complete the errand.
greet.cold.2: You again? I have nothing to say to you.
greet.1.1: Oh, it's you. What can I do for you?
greet.1.2: Back again? Go on, what is it?
greet.2.1: Good to see you! How can I help?
greet.2.2: There you are! What brings you by?
greet.3.1: My friend! Come, sit. What do you need?
greet.3.2: Ah, someone I trust. What can I do for you today?
greet.4.1: You! The whole village talks about you. Anything for you.
greet.4.2: My dearest friend. Ask, and it's yours.
greet.trial: Before we go further, I want to test you.
trade.busy: This villager is trading with someone else.
fame.legend_goods: The trader has heard of you and shows you something special.
patron.title: Patron of the village
patron.chat: You are the patron of %s. Trades there: -%s%. You can name the village at the bell.
patron.broadcast_took: %s is now the patron of %s, in place of %s.
patron.how: Hero of the Village and every trust trial passed with %s/%s villagers make you patron.
patron.label: Patron:
patron.challenge: You qualify. More standing points than the patron take the place.
patron.rename_text: As patron you choose the village's name. Everyone sees it.
patron.rename_bad: That name won't do (1 to 32 characters).
group.title: Village order: %s
group.reward: Reward: %s emeralds split by share, plus experience, fame and standing. Paid from %s% up.
group.nothing: You have nothing for this order
group.given: You gave %s for the village order.
group.paid: The village order "%s" in %s is done! Your share: %s emeralds.
group.paid_partial: The month ended before "%s" in %s was done. Your share: %s emeralds.
group.mail: %s emeralds went to your Ender Chest.
group.mail_full: Your Ender Chest is full: %s emeralds are waiting.
group.food.name: Winter stores
group.food.desc: Winter is coming and the cellars are empty. Every bite helps.
group.food.items: Wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, bread, apples, cooked meat and fish...
group.wood.name: Timber for repairs
group.wood.desc: The storm took half the roofs. We need wood.
group.stone.name: New walls
group.stone.desc: The elders want a wall around the village. That takes a lot of stone.
group.stone.items: Cobblestone, stone, stone bricks, cobbled deepslate, andesite, diorite, granite, tuff.
group.iron.name: Iron for the smithy
group.iron.desc: The smiths have work for a whole year and no iron.
group.wool.name: Warm winter
group.wool.desc: Blankets for every home before the frost.
group.defend.name: Defend the village
group.defend.desc: Monsters come closer every night. Drive them off.
group.defend.want: Wanted: %s monsters slain in the village
group.defend.items: Any hostile mob killed inside the village counts.
contract.name: Contract for %s
legend.title: Legendary!
legend.armorer.name: %s's Breastplate
legend.armorer.lore: Forged in %s for the one who kept the forge burning.
legend.weaponsmith.name: %s's Blade
legend.weaponsmith.lore:
The finest blade %s ever made.
Its smith wept to part with it.
legend.toolsmith.name: %s's Pickaxe
legend.toolsmith.lore: From %s. It has never met a stone it could not break.
legend.farmer.name: %s's Hoe
legend.farmer.lore: Every field in %s was once turned with this hoe.
legend.fisherman.name: %s's Rod
legend.fisherman.lore: The rod that fed %s through three hard winters.
legend.fletcher.name: %s's Bow
legend.fletcher.lore: Strung in %s. It never misses twice.
legend.librarian.name: %s's Helm of Wisdom
legend.librarian.lore:
Worn by the scholars of %s.
Thoughts come clearer under it.
legend.cartographer.name: %s's Travelling Boots
legend.cartographer.lore: These boots walked every road out of %s.
legend.cleric.name: %s's Quiet Leggings
legend.cleric.lore: Blessed in %s. Your steps make no sound.
legend.butcher.name: %s's Cleaver
legend.butcher.lore: Every feast in %s was carved with it.
legend.leatherworker.name: %s's Wings
legend.leatherworker.lore: Stitched in %s from a story no one believes.
legend.mason.name: %s's Trowel
legend.shepherd.name: %s's Shield
legend.shepherd.lore: It kept the flocks of %s safe from every wolf.
contract.days_left: New contracts come every week (next in %s days).
lore.weaponsmith.reforge: Forge me a few. The best one I'll enchant for you.
lore.armorer.reforge: Make me a pair. One goes to the guards, the other I enchant for you.
lore.toolsmith.reforge: Bring me a few. One of them I'll enchant for you, the rest go to the miners.
lore.fletcher.reforge: Make me a few. The best one I'll enchant for you.
lore.order.winter_stock: Winter is coming and the cellar is empty.
lore.order.feast: The harvest is in. Tonight the whole village eats.
lore.order.smiths_lunch: The smiths work through noon. Someone has to feed them.
lore.order.fish_market: Market day. My stall should smell of the sea.
lore.order.new_home: A young couple moved in. Their house is bare.
lore.order.reading_room: I'm opening a reading room for the children.
lore.order.expedition_kit: I'm going farther than ever. I need the right things.
lore.order.healers_kit: If a raid comes, I want to be ready.
lore.order.guard_gear: Our guards fight in shirts. That has to change.
lore.order.armory: The armory is empty and the raiders know it.
lore.order.tool_set: The new miner showed up with bare hands.
lore.order.town_hall: The town hall is falling apart. We rebuild it in stone.
lore.order.hunters_pack: My son goes on his first hunt tomorrow.
lore.order.riders_set: A traveler rides out at dawn. Fully equipped.
lore.order.beekeeper: The hives are full this year. Help me bring it all in.
lore.order.ancient_seeds: My grandfather spoke of flowers older than the village.
lore.order.wedding: My daughter is getting married. The table must be the finest in the valley.
lore.order.rainbow: The festival needs every colour of wool. All sixteen.
lore.order.color_set: The weavers want colour. Plain white won't do this season.
lore.order.potions: The next raid will not wait for me to find the ingredients.
lore.order.smith_order: A lord from far away wants a blade that never breaks.
lore.order.armored_stable: Every horse in the village will wear armour. Every single one.
lore.order.picnic: A picnic by the river. Don't tell anyone, it's a surprise.
lore.armorer.craft.1: Iron blocks stack better than loose ingots.
lore.armorer.craft.2: I'm stocking up before the winter.
lore.armorer.fill_bucket.1: My forge needs lava, and I'm too old for caves.
lore.armorer.fill_bucket.2: Coal runs out fast. Lava burns for ages.
lore.armorer.kill.1: Something keeps scratching at my door at night.
lore.armorer.kill.2: I can't make armor fast enough. Thin them out.
lore.armorer.kill.cow: I need leather for straps. Armor needs straps.
lore.armorer.mine.1: I'd dig it myself, but someone has to mind the forge.
lore.armorer.smelt.1: Raw ore is no use to me. Smelt it first.
lore.armorer.smelt.2: My furnace runs day and night. Give me a hand.
lore.armorer.summon.1: The village needs a guard that never sleeps.
lore.armorer.summon.2: Iron walks better than it fights. Usually.
lore.butcher.breed.1: Hungry winter ahead. The pens need more animals.
lore.butcher.breed.2: The pens have been half empty since the raid.
lore.butcher.craft.2: The smokehouse needs fuel, and kelp burns well.
lore.butcher.deliver.1: I'm short on a few things for the kitchen.
lore.butcher.deliver.2: Fresh things sell fast at the market.
lore.butcher.harvest.1: The pigs won't follow me without carrots.
lore.butcher.harvest.2: Carrots for the stew and a few for the pigs.
lore.butcher.kill.1: Monsters got two of my chickens last night.
lore.butcher.kill.2: I can't work with something moaning at the window.
lore.butcher.kill.cow: Beef for the market, hides for the tanner.
lore.butcher.kill.pig: Everyone wants smoked pork. Only smoked pork.
lore.butcher.kill.chicken: Roast chicken on Sunday. The whole village comes.
lore.butcher.kill.sheep: Mutton stew keeps the miners on their feet.
lore.butcher.mine.1: The smokehouse eats coal like bread.
lore.cartographer.craft.1: My tools wore out on the last trip.
lore.cartographer.craft.2: I can't map what I can't see.
lore.cartographer.craft.paper: I use paper faster than I can make it.
lore.cartographer.craft.map: Every map I draw, some traveler takes.
lore.cartographer.craft.compass: I dropped my compass in a river. Don't ask.
lore.cartographer.craft.spyglass: A good lens shows you a mountain a day away.
lore.cartographer.deliver.1: Cane makes paper, and paper makes maps.
lore.cartographer.kill.1: They chased me off the road last week.
lore.cartographer.kill.2: I can't draw a place I can't get close to.
lore.cartographer.kill.phantom: Those things in the sky won't let me sleep outside.
lore.cartographer.mine.1: My instruments need a few special stones.
lore.cartographer.mine.2: I'd go myself, but I get lost underground.
lore.cartographer.mine.redstone_ores: A compass needs redstone, and I need a compass.
lore.cartographer.smelt.2: The storm broke my workshop window.
lore.cartographer.tame.1: I need company on the road.
lore.cartographer.tame.2: The roads are long and lonely.
lore.cartographer.tame.horse: I need a horse for the long roads.
lore.cartographer.tame.parrot: A parrot on the shoulder scares off bandits.
lore.cartographer.visit_biome.1: I heard of a place nobody has drawn yet. Go see.
lore.cartographer.visit_biome.2: My map has a blank spot. Fill it for me.
lore.cartographer.visit_structure.1: Travelers talk about ruins out there. True?
lore.cartographer.visit_structure.2: Once you've seen it, I'll put it on the map.
lore.cartographer.visit_structure.pillag: There's a bandit camp nearby. I need to know where.
lore.cartographer.visit_structure.monume: Fishermen say there's a temple under the sea.
lore.cartographer.visit_structure.mansio: They say a mansion stands in the dark forest.
lore.cartographer.visit_structure.trial_: Copper halls underground? I want them on my map.
lore.cleric.brew.1: The wounded keep coming and I'm out of potions.
lore.cleric.brew.2: A potion on the shelf saves a life at night.
lore.cleric.craft.1: I need it for my potions.
lore.cleric.craft.2: My brewing stand is cold without it.
lore.cleric.craft.glass_bottle: Every potion needs a bottle, and I keep breaking them.
lore.cleric.craft.blaze_powder: Blaze powder is the fire in every potion.
lore.cleric.cure.1: He was my neighbor. Bring him back.
lore.cleric.cure.2: A golden apple and a little faith. Save one for me.
lore.cleric.harvest.1: Every potion starts with nether wart.
lore.cleric.harvest.2: Nether wart grows slowly. Mine is gone.
lore.cleric.kill.1: The dead don't rest around here. Put them to rest.
lore.cleric.kill.2: I pray every night, but prayers don't stop arrows.
lore.cleric.kill.witch: That witch poisoned our well. I'm sure of it.
lore.cleric.kill.blaze: Fire spirits guard what my potions need.
lore.cleric.kill.rabbit: A rabbit's foot is lucky. For the potion, not the rabbit.
lore.cleric.mine.1: The temple needs a few stones from deep below.
lore.cleric.mine.2: Lapis for blessings, redstone for long potions.
lore.cleric.smelt.1: Gold for the altar. It must be pure.
lore.cleric.smelt.2: Gold nuggets won't do. I need ingots.
lore.farmer.bonemeal.1: The fields are slow this year. Give them a push.
lore.farmer.bonemeal.2: Bone meal works wonders on tired soil.
lore.farmer.breed.2: A fox got half my hens.
lore.farmer.craft.1: My hands are full with the fields. Can you make some?
lore.farmer.craft.2: There's a feast coming and I'm behind.
lore.farmer.craft.bread: Fresh bread for the whole street.
lore.farmer.craft.cake: My daughter's birthday. A cake would make her day.
lore.farmer.craft.golden_carrot: Golden carrots for the horses. They've earned it.
lore.farmer.craft.hay_block: Bales for the animals. Winter is long.
lore.farmer.craft.pumpkin_pie: Pumpkin pie, like my mother used to make.
lore.farmer.craft.bone_meal: Bones are no use to me. Bone meal is.
lore.farmer.deliver.1: I'm short on a few things this week.
lore.farmer.deliver.2: Market day is tomorrow and my stall is empty.
lore.farmer.harvest.1: The crop is ready and my back is not.
lore.farmer.harvest.2: One more day in the field and the crows get it.
lore.farmer.kill.1: Something tramples my crops at night.
lore.farmer.kill.2: I can't harvest with zombies in the rows.
lore.farmer.kill.rabbit: Rabbits ate half my carrots. Enough.
lore.farmer.plant.1: My knees can't take another day of planting.
lore.farmer.plant.2: Plant the far field for me. I'll pay well.
lore.fisherman.catch.1: They don't bite for me lately. Maybe for you.
lore.fisherman.catch.2: Half the village eats fish on Fridays.
lore.fisherman.deliver.1: The sea gives strange things. I collect them.
lore.fisherman.deliver.2: My nets need mending and my shelves are empty.
lore.fisherman.fill_bucket.1: A little fish for my tank. My grandson loves them.
lore.fisherman.fill_bucket.2: Live fish fetch twice the price.
lore.fisherman.fill_bucket.axolotl_bucke: They say axolotls live in the lush caves. I want one.
lore.fisherman.kill.1: Something in the water keeps tearing my nets.
lore.fisherman.kill.2: I won't take the boat out until they're gone.
lore.fisherman.kill.squid: I need ink for my ledger. The squid have plenty.
lore.fisherman.kill.guardian: The temple fish nearly sank my boat.
lore.fisherman.mine.1: Smoked fish needs a good fire.
lore.fisherman.mine.2: The smokehouse is cold. I need coal.
lore.fisherman.smelt.1: Cooked fish sells better than raw.
lore.fisherman.smelt.2: The sailors want their fish hot.
lore.fisherman.visit_structure.1: My grandfather's ship sank somewhere near here.
lore.fisherman.visit_structure.2: Wrecks wash up after storms. Go and look.
lore.fletcher.craft.1: The guards keep asking for more arrows.
lore.fletcher.craft.2: My workshop can't keep up with the orders.
lore.fletcher.craft.bow: A good bow takes time, and I have none.
lore.fletcher.craft.stick: Sticks, sticks, sticks. That's my whole life.
lore.fletcher.kill.1: Skeletons shoot better than our guards. Shameful.
lore.fletcher.kill.2: I make the arrows, you use them.
lore.fletcher.kill.chicken: I need feathers for my arrows.
lore.fletcher.kill.spider: Spider silk makes the best bowstrings.
lore.fletcher.smelt.2: The crossbows need iron. Lots of iron.
lore.leatherworker.breed.1: More cows, more leather. That's how it works.
lore.leatherworker.breed.2: The herd is thin. I'll run out of hides.
lore.leatherworker.craft.1: I need dye for the saddles. White is in fashion.
lore.leatherworker.deliver.1: A few odd things for my workshop.
lore.leatherworker.deliver.2: My tools are dull and my stock is low.
lore.leatherworker.deliver.turtle_scute: A turtle shell helmet. Someone ordered one.
lore.leatherworker.kill.1: Something chews my hides at night.
lore.leatherworker.kill.2: The tannery smells. It draws monsters.
lore.leatherworker.kill.cow: I need hides, and hides come from cows.
lore.leatherworker.kill.rabbit: Rabbit hide is soft. Perfect for gloves.
lore.leatherworker.kill.phantom: Phantom skin mends elytra. The rich pay well.
lore.leatherworker.kill.spider: I need thread to stitch the saddles.
lore.leatherworker.smelt.1: Buckles and rings for the harness.
lore.leatherworker.smelt.2: A saddle needs iron, not just leather.
lore.leatherworker.tame.1: A good saddle needs an animal to try it on.
lore.leatherworker.tame.2: I make the gear. Someone has to ride.
lore.leatherworker.tame.horse: I made a saddle. Now I need a horse to fit it.
lore.leatherworker.tame.donkey: A donkey carries more than you think.
lore.leatherworker.tame.llama: Llamas carry packs and spit at thieves.
lore.librarian.craft.1: The library grows and the shelves are full.
lore.librarian.craft.2: Write it down or lose it. That's my rule.
lore.librarian.craft.bookshelf: More books than shelves. A good problem.
lore.librarian.craft.clock: I lose track of time when I read.
lore.librarian.craft.lantern: I read late. My eyes need light.
lore.librarian.enchant.1: Show me you understand the old words.
lore.librarian.enchant.2: I study enchantments. I need someone to practice them.
lore.librarian.kill.1: Strange things roam at night. I want to study them.
lore.librarian.kill.2: A book about monsters needs a few samples.
lore.librarian.kill.squid: Ink for my quills. The squid won't mind much.
lore.librarian.kill.glow_squid: Glowing ink. Imagine a book that shines in the dark.
lore.librarian.kill.enderman: Ender pearls. The old books speak of them.
lore.mason.craft.1: We're rebuilding the well. I need materials.
lore.mason.craft.2: Good walls start with good bricks.
lore.mason.kill.2: I can't build with monsters at my back.
lore.mason.kill.creeper: A creeper blew a hole in my wall. Never again.
lore.mason.kill.silverfish: Something lives in my stones and eats the mortar.
lore.mason.mine.1: I need good stone for the new houses.
lore.mason.mine.2: My quarry is empty. Dig some for me.
lore.mason.smelt.1: Smooth stone for the temple steps.
lore.mason.smelt.2: Cobble is ugly. Bake it into proper stone.
lore.mason.station.1: Stone bricks look better on the town hall.
lore.mason.station.2: Cut them neat. The mayor is watching.
lore.nitwit.craft.1: I'm hungry. Make me something sweet?
lore.nitwit.craft.2: I'd do it myself, but I don't know how.
lore.nitwit.deliver.1: I just like it. Is that a crime?
lore.nitwit.deliver.2: Nobody gives me anything. Will you?
lore.nitwit.kill.1: The green blobs keep bouncing at me.
lore.nitwit.kill.2: They laughed at me. The blobs did.
lore.nitwit.mine.1: I want melon. A lot of melon.
lore.nitwit.mine.2: Melon is the best food. Fight me.
lore.nitwit.tame.1: I want a cat. Everyone has a cat.
lore.nitwit.tame.2: A cat would listen to me. Nobody else does.
lore.shepherd.breed.1: The flock is too small for winter.
lore.shepherd.breed.2: Lambs in spring, wool in summer.
lore.shepherd.craft.2: I sell what I make and make what sells.
lore.shepherd.craft.lead: Sheep wander. Leads keep them home.
lore.shepherd.craft.shears: My shears went blunt on the last flock.
lore.shepherd.craft.wool_carpets: Carpets for the town hall floor.
lore.shepherd.harvest.2: Sheep follow wheat. I need a lot of it.
lore.shepherd.kill.1: Spiders scare my sheep half to death.
lore.shepherd.kill.2: Something got into the pen last night.
lore.shepherd.shear.1: My hands ache. Shear them for me.
lore.shepherd.shear.2: Wool keeps the whole village warm.
lore.shepherd.tame.1: A good dog keeps the wolves away.
lore.shepherd.tame.2: My old dog is tired. He needs help.
lore.toolsmith.craft.1: My forge needs fuel and handles.
lore.toolsmith.craft.2: I'm behind on orders. Help me out.
lore.toolsmith.deliver.1: Flint and steel. Every home needs one.
lore.toolsmith.kill.1: Cave spiders bit the miner's boy. Clear them out.
lore.toolsmith.kill.2: My customers won't go into the mines anymore.
lore.toolsmith.mine.2: I need fresh ore. The old stock is gone.
lore.toolsmith.smelt.1: Ingots, not ore. My furnace is full.
lore.toolsmith.smelt.2: You smelt it and I'll forge it.
lore.weaponsmith.craft.2: Even a sword needs a grip.
lore.weaponsmith.deliver.2: The guards burn through flint like crazy.
lore.weaponsmith.enchant.1: A sword without magic is just a sword.
lore.weaponsmith.enchant.2: I forge the blade. You put the magic in it.
lore.weaponsmith.kill.1: Test my blades on the real thing.
lore.weaponsmith.kill.creeper: Gunpowder for... research. Don't tell the cleric.
lore.weaponsmith.kill.enderman: Ender pearls. I have an idea for a blade.
lore.weaponsmith.mine.1: I need ore for the next batch of swords.
lore.weaponsmith.mine.2: The best steel needs the best fuel.
lore.weaponsmith.smelt.1: Ingots for blades. Bring them clean.
lore.weaponsmith.smelt.2: My apprentice burned the last batch.
button.give_part_tip: The villager keeps it. Bring the rest later.
msg.gave_part: You gave %s. Bring the rest when you have it.
confirm.abandon_kept: The %s things you already gave stay with the villager.
map.none: Nobody here knows the way to %s. You'll have to find it.

chart.use: Use it to unfold the map
chart.nothing: No %s near here. Try somewhere else.
group.paid_xp: The village order "%s" in %s is done! Your share: %s experience.
group.paid_partial_xp: The month ended before "%s" in %s was done. Your share: %s experience.
villagersremember.config.language.toolti: Language of the mod's texts. Auto uses each player's game language.
villagersremember.config.talkMenu.toolti: On: right-click greets you with Trade and Errands, sneak + right-click trades. Off: right-click trades as usual, sneak + right-click opens the errands.
Right-click on a village bell opens the village board. Sneak + right-click still rings it.
villagersremember.config.villageRadius.t: How far from the bell the village's villagers are looked for, in blocks.
villagersremember.config.maxActiveErrand: How many errands one player can carry at the same time.
villagersremember.config.errandsPerLevel: Errands a villager offers a day, for trade levels 1 to 5.
villagersremember.config.respectedBonusE: One more errand from each villager once you are Respected in the village.
Off: errands, contracts and village orders pay no emeralds. Experience and standing stay, and so does the treasury.
villagersremember.config.xpMultiplier.to: Experience from errands, contracts and village orders, times the usual amount. 1 is normal, 0 is none.
villagersremember.config.tierEmeraldsPer: Emeralds' worth paid for a minute of work, for packs 1 to 5. Split into emeralds and experience.
villagersremember.config.marketPremium.t: An errand pays at least this many times what villagers would pay for its goods.
villagersremember.config.xpPerEmerald.to: Experience points for each emerald's worth of reward.
villagersremember.config.maxEmeraldsPerE: The most emeralds one errand pays.
villagersremember.config.trialCountFacto: How much more a trial of trust asks than a normal errand of its pack.
villagersremember.config.trialRewardMult: How much more a trial of trust pays than a normal errand.
Trade prices follow your standing: cheaper for friends, dearer after harming the village.
villagersremember.config.discountPerVill: Discount for each tier with the villager. 0.04 is 4%.
Discount for each tier with the village. 0.06 is 6%.
villagersremember.config.maxDiscount.too: The biggest discount from standing. 0.40 is 40%.
villagersremember.config.surchargePerNeg: Price rise for each point below zero. 0.01 is 1%.
villagersremember.config.maxSurcharge.to: The highest price rise for players who harmed the village. 0.50 is 50%.
The patron of a village trades there at this discount. 0.45 is 45%.
villagersremember.config.hitPenalty.tool: Standing lost with the villager and the village for hitting a villager.
villagersremember.config.killPenalty.too: Standing lost for killing a villager.
villagersremember.config.treasuryShare: Share a game day by tier
villagersremember.config.treasuryShare.t: Emeralds a game day each working villager sets aside, by your tier with them (Stranger to Best friend).
villagersremember.config.treasuryVillage: The treasury income times this, by your tier with the village.
villagersremember.config.treasuryDailyCa: The most emeralds one village sets aside a game day.
villagersremember.config.treasuryKeepDay: How many days of income a village keeps for you.
villagersremember.config.networkBonusPer: Extra income for each village where you are at least Friend. 0.05 is 5%.
villagersremember.config.networkBonusMax: The cap of that bonus. 0.25 is 25%.
villagersremember.config.fameTitles.tool: Helper, Benefactor and Legend in front of names in chat and TAB. Turn off if another mod manages teams.
villagersremember.config.contracts.toolt: Once a week every Best friend has a big job in three parts.
villagersremember.config.contractMinutes: About how many minutes of work a contract takes.
villagersremember.config.contractRewardM: Contracts pay the top pack rate times this.
villagersremember.config.contractMaxEmer: The most emeralds one contract pays.
villagersremember.config.contractsForLeg: Contracts for one profession that bring its legendary item.
villagersremember.config.groupOrders.too: Once a game month every village posts one big order for the whole server.
Game days between village orders. 30 is a game month.
villagersremember.config.groupOrderScale: Size of an order for each regular player. 1 is 512 food, 256 logs or 50 monsters.
villagersremember.config.groupRegularDay: Game days online in the last period to count as a regular player.
villagersremember.config.groupRewardEmer: Emeralds a finished order pays for each regular player, shared by what each one brought.
villagersremember.config.groupMinShare.t: Helpers who brought less than this share get nothing. 0.02 is 2%.
villagersremember.config.showMarkers.too: "!" over villagers with work for you, "?" when you can hand something in. Only you see them.
villagersremember.config.markerRange.too: How far the markers show, in blocks.
villagersremember.config.villagerNames.t: Always above the head, only when you look at the villager, or off.
villagersremember.config.villagerNameRan: How far villager names show, in blocks.
villagersremember.config.showTracker.too: Followed errands in the sidebar. It replaces any other sidebar while you have errands.
villagersremember.config.chartLook.toolt: Folded charts: a globe, Dungeons and Taverns' rolled chart, or auto (the chart when that mod is there).
villagersremember.config.title: Villagers Remember settings
villagersremember.config.note.server: These are the server's settings. Saving changes them for everyone.
villagersremember.config.note.local: Settings for your single player worlds.
villagersremember.config.note.other_serv: This server doesn't run the mod. These are the settings for your single player worlds.
villagersremember.config.denied: Only server admins can change these settings.
villagersremember.config.waystoneNames.t: Waystones in a village (Waystones mod or KawaMood's Waystones datapack) get its English name. Waystones a player named keep their name.
trust.first: %s looks like they want to talk to you.
trust.new: %s has heard about you and wants to talk.
greet.locked.1: Hm? I don't know you. Ask %s.
villagersremember.config.gradualTrust.to: In a new village one villager talks to you first. Each tier you reach with someone who trusts you, and the village's own standing, opens up another. Off: everyone offers errands at once.
villagersremember.config.trustVillageBon: How many more villagers open up at each village tier: Stranger, Known, Friend, Respected, Hero. -1 means everyone.
trust.order: The village is talking about how you helped with the order.
lore.have.ender_chest: You've been good to us. Get yourself an ender chest: now and then we'll leave a little something in it for you.
trust.traded: %s liked trading with you and wants to talk.
